setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays through the test device on an 8-step loop at 90 BPM, rate /1. Pattern 1 holds C, D, E, F (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65; velocities 127, 117, 107, 97) on steps 1 to 4 and pattern 2 holds a C at velocity 100 on steps 3 and 6. Both patterns are assigned to channel 1 and Strategy is still SKIP. Merge modes is open for channel 1. In this scene a Seed makes a repeatable draw of which pattern each fragment comes from: the same seed always gives the same choice.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Select Strategy and turn E3 to FRAGMENTS. Strategy and Active both read FRAGMENTS: the loop will be cut into fragments and each fragment will come from one source pattern, chosen by the Seed.
steps.title: Choose Fragments

steps.caption: Open Merge Shape > Rhythm. Turn E3 once left so Size reads 4 and press K3. The footer reads APPLIED and the eight-step loop is now cut into two four-step fragments, one for steps 1 to 4 and one for steps 5 to 8. On the grid only step 3 is bright: with the starting seed the first fragment comes from pattern 2 (a note on step 3 only) and the second from pattern 1, which has no notes in steps 5 to 8.
steps.title: Set Size to 4

steps.caption: Tap Play (1,8), let two loops sound, then tap Stop. Each loop plays one C (MIDI 60) at velocity 100, a single note in the strip below. Seed 0 gives steps 1 to 4 to pattern 2 and steps 5 to 8 to pattern 1, which has no trigs there, and pattern 1's own E on step 3 is not mixed in.
steps.title: Seed 0 picks the sparse draw

steps.caption: Turn E2 to Seed and turn E3 once right so it reads 1. The grid still shows the result of seed 0 until you apply the change.
steps.title: Pick seed 1

steps.caption: Press K3. The footer reads APPLIED and the grid now lights steps 1, 2, 3, 4 and 6. Seed 1 gives steps 1 to 4 to pattern 1 and steps 5 to 8 to pattern 2. Try other seeds, 2, 3 and so on, and listen for how each draw reshuffles the fragments.
steps.title: Apply seed 1

steps.caption: Tap Play, let two loops sound, then tap Stop. Each loop plays pattern 1's C D E F (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65 at velocities 127, 117, 107, 97) and then pattern 2's C on step 6 at velocity 100. Each fragment keeps the notes and velocities of the pattern it came from.
steps.title: Each fragment keeps its source

title: Let each fragment keep its source notes
